# Does secrets: inherit hand your secrets to the wrong workflow?

> Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find every secrets: inherit call that hands your whole secret set to an external reusable workflow, or to a job a fork can trigger. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
